title: dev.hugr.corelink.dsr.erasure.completed.v1
description: Pipeline terminal: dsr_tickets.status → 'completed'. Audit fires BEFORE the canonical status transition + the customer-facing email notification with the BLAKE3-signed erasure-report.json signed URL (24h TTL). Only fires post a successful 24h verification sweep (`dsr.erasure.verification_passed.v1` precedes).

completed_at_ms.description: Unix epoch ms; canonical clock_stop F-11 instant per privacy_model.md §6.1.

report_signature_hex.description: BLAKE3-keyed MAC signature (32 bytes hex) over the canonical JCS-canonical erasure-report.json payload.

report_signed_url_ttl_seconds.description: Canonical 24h TTL on the customer-facing R2 evidence-dsr signed URL.
